components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single leading action of a section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(0.72 0.19 295); color: oklch(0.12 0.02 295); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.72 0.19 295 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.19 295 / 0.5); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative action next to a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(0.269 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.269 0 0), oklch(0.985 0 0) 5%); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.19 295 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Low-emphasis utility actions such as copying the invite link.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 15%); border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 4.5%); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 7.5%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.72 0.19 295); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.19 295 / 0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field for group name, member name and Last.fm user.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 15%); border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 4.5%); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font: 400 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.708 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.72 0.19 295); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.19 295 / 0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default container with a 1px translucent ring.
components.html:
Criar grupo

Monte um grupo com os amigos.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.18 0.015 285); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.985 0 0 / 10%); font: 400 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: oklch(0.708 0 0); }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Two-up mode and kind selector; the selected option fills amethyst.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.13 0.012 285 / 0.4); } .ds-seg button { padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.708 0 0); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: oklch(0.72 0.19 295); color: oklch(0.12 0.02 295); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.19 295 / 0.5); }

components.name: Member Row
components.description: Member with initial avatar, leader crown and status badge.
components.css: .ds-member { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.18 0.015 285); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font: 400 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-avatar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.72 0.19 295 / 0.15); color: oklch(0.72 0.19 295); font-weight: 600; } .ds-member-name { flex: 1; font-weight: 500; } .ds-you { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.708 0 0); } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.72 0.19 295); color: oklch(0.12 0.02 295); font: 500 12px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Vote Tile
components.description: Cover-forward candidate; the chosen one carries a ring, halo and tick.
components.css: .ds-vote { position: relative; display: block; width: 180px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.18 0.015 285); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); text-align: left; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-vote:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-vote[aria-pressed='true'] { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.72 0.19 295), 0 0 28px -6px oklch(0.72 0.19 295); } .ds-cover { aspect-ratio: 1; background: conic-gradient(from 200deg, oklch(0.35 0.1 260), oklch(0.5 0.14 300), oklch(0.3 0.08 250)); } .ds-vote-meta { padding: 10px; } .ds-vote-title { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-vote-sub { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; color: oklch(0.708 0 0); font-size: 12px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
A dark, quiet room where the album cover is the only light source. The interface is a low-lit graphite shell tinted faintly violet; everything that is not the music steps back. Color is rationed: a single amethyst accent marks the one thing that matters on a screen at that moment (the roulette needle, the leader's primary action, the vote you cast). Typography is plain and confident, one family, no ornament. The product's drama lives in the roulette and the reveal, not in the chrome around them.

The system is dark-only by design. It is built for phones held in a dim living room, at a gathering, with friends beside you. Density is comfortable and touch-sized; most screens are a single column of sections that never exceeds a 56rem reading width.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite with a violet undertone (hue 285), never pure black and never a light mode.
One accent (amethyst, hue 295), used sparingly and with a glow only at moments of decision.
Covers are the imagery; ornament is almost nonexistent.
Flat, tonal surfaces with 1px translucent rings instead of drop shadows.
Rounded but not pillowy: 10px controls, 14px cards, 18px for the roulette frame.
Motion is spring-based and purposeful: entrances, the reveal, the vote tick.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amethyst is the only accent. If two things on a screen are amethyst, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Cover Is The Light Rule
rules.body: Saturated color comes from album covers. The interface never competes with a cover for chroma.

rules.name: The Numbers Align Rule
rules.body: Durations and track numbers use tabular numerals so columns stay in line.

rules.name: The Glow Is An Event Rule
rules.body: A violet glow appears only when something has been decided or is being decided. Never on idle resting surfaces.

dos: Do let the album cover be the brightest, most colorful object on screen.
Do keep amethyst to one purpose per screen (The One Lamp Rule).
Do use the 14px / 10px radius pair and the 1px translucent ring for surfaces.
Do use springs for entrances and the 7s deceleration curve for the roulette; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep copy in informal Brazilian Portuguese with progressive verbs for waiting states.
Do keep the page single-column and phone-first, touch targets at least 32px.
donts: Don't introduce a light theme, a second accent hue, or a gradient text treatment.
Don't add decorative glows to resting surfaces; glow marks a decision.
Don't use pure black or pure white backgrounds; stay on the violet-tinted graphite.
Don't add a second typeface or serif display for flavor.
Don't use identical icon-plus-heading-plus-blurb card grids; the product is sections and covers, not feature tiles.
Don't hide state: whose turn it is, who is ready, and who has voted must always be visible.
